description.value: A family-owned motel established in 1960 in the heart of Lillooet, 4 Pines Motel spans three buildings offering everything from budget rooms to honeymoon suites with jacuzzi and fireplace. Its downtown location puts touring cyclists within walking distance of Lillooet's services, and the motel sits along the scenic Highway 99 corridor connecting Whistler and the Interior. Rooms range from simple queens to full two-bedroom kitchen suites suited for longer stays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms contact details matching OSM. The amenities page explicitly lists an on-site laundromat and the homepage mentions high-speed internet, providing positive evidence for those amenities. Neither bike storage nor staff bike-handling procedures are mentioned anywhere on the site, so both required criteria remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: 4 Pines Motel is a legitimate, operating accommodation in Lillooet well-positioned for touring cyclists on the Hwy 99/12 corridor, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website. Direct contact is needed to determine whether the property can meet these requirements before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number 1-800-753-2576 and email 4pines@4pinesmotel.com are available for follow-up contact to verify bike storage arrangements.

Laundry.detail: Amenities page states: 'With 4 Pines Motel's convenient on-site laundromat facilities, you'll never have to over-pack on clothing.'
